summary: Esperion Therapeutics filed an 8-K on June 9, 2026 (Item 8.01) reporting that the Bundeskartellamt cleared its pending merger with an affiliate of ArchiMed SAS. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 1, 2026, Essence MergerCo Inc. will merge with and into Esperion, with the company surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. Completion remains subject to HSR Act waiting periods and stockholder approval; a special meeting is scheduled for July 8, 2026. No financial terms (price per share) are specified in this filing. The antitrust clearance removes one key condition; watch for stockholder vote and remaining regulatory steps to gauge closing timing.
